review_notes.evidence: AL and AP sockets read E-B4G5; AT F-E4H2 and AW F-E4G3. Source lower AV is2N; upper third3354 gate is BD5E. No source gate substituted from A1 or neighboring page.

Direct native annotated proof traces +D07 from row59 left loop via61 up53 to107 down66 into AJ D05. AF output D02 takes133 up50 to176 down59 into AB upper. BB physical B09 drives BE upper directly, while its unnamed unit-row output loops via134 up57 and160 down61 to BF. These readings are pending independent root confirmation.

AY has D07 on function row80, D09 on unit row82. D09 bends upward at131 to80 and joins the D07-to-AW input path; there is no large printed diamond at this three-arm physical tie, so do not invent one. Preserve both physical outputs as additional_driver_outputs.

The printed alternate reference and the hanging primary reference both literally read RT321AT4. Full enlarged native proof retains the open star, both references and the hanging diamond42row52. The branch at114row52 into AY requires independent native junction check.
